text: $ETH/$BTC slipped 0.711% while $BTC itself dropped 0.513% over 24 h. Meanwhile the 20-coin basket nudged up 0.613%, meaning the average alt outpaced Bitcoin. So BTC's lagging the alt crowd, but ETH's losing ground against its own benchmark. Overall a modest tilt toward the broader alt set, with $BTC and $ETH both in the red. Nothing wild, just a small shift in relative strength.

$SUI is up about 4.4% at $1.16, and its 24-hour swing was only 7.3% versus a typical 11.1% range. That's roughly a third tighter than usual, so the price has been moving in a narrower band.

$ZEC popped 2.7% to $1,414, with a 7.4% daily range compared to its usual 9.4%. That's also somewhat tighter, the market kept it more confined than it normally does.

$QNT surged 26.4% to $281.55, but its 30.8% swing was close to the 36% it normally sees, so the range was basically in line with the norm.

All three moved, but $SUI and $ZEC showed the most constrained action. Nothing wild, just a tighter-than-usual day for those two.

$AVAX just ripped through a swing that was almost twice its usual daily range, ending the session around $11.43 after a 9.5% jump.

$BABY managed a noticeably wider bounce, trading near $0.0140 and up about 6.5% as its 24-hour spread hit roughly 10%, well above the typical 7.7% band.

$ETH stayed pretty tame, hovering at $2,679 with a flat-lined 0.0% move and a range only slightly bigger than normal.

All three moved enough to catch the eye, but only $AVAX and $BABY really broke out of their usual patterns.

Nothing wild beyond that.

$BTC slipped 1.19% to $83,180.68, after testing a high of $84,563.99 and finding support near $82,775.94. Volume sat at about 13,717 BTC, pushing roughly $1.15 B in quote volume.

$ETH dropped 1.29% to $2,680.26, having peaked at $2,748.60 before bouncing back to a low of $2,652.20. Trade flow was solid, with 314,843 ETH changing hands and $851 M in USDT moving through the pair.

$BNB fell 2.34% to $754.60, sliding from a top of $773.44 down to $752.19. It logged 126,272 BNB traded, generating about $96.2 M in quote volume.

All three majors retreated over the last day, with $BNB taking the steepest bite. Keep an eye on whether the lows hold as the market digests the pullback. Looks like a modest down-trend across the board this morning.

$BTC nudged up 1.55% to $84,330, hitting a high of $84,381.3 before easing back to a low of $82,563. Volume sat around 15,642 BTC, translating to roughly $1.31 B in quote volume.

$ETH sprinted 2.39% to $2,728.98, peaked at $2,735 and found support near $2,651.68. Heavy action with 292,266 ETH traded, about $786.9 M on the USDT side.

$BNB inched higher, +0.41% to $766.32, topping out at $773.45 and bottoming at $753.81. It moved 133,033 BNB, roughly $101.6 M in quote volume.

Watch the $ETH order flow around the $2,730-$2,750 band; any break could set the tone for the next session.

$ETH is nudging up 1.002% against $BTC, so it's gaining a bit of ground in BTC terms. Meanwhile $BTC posted a 1.634% rise over the last 24 hours. The 20-coin basket of top-traded alts moved even faster, up about 3.469%, leaving $BTC lagging behind the broader alt pack. In short, $ETH is tightening the spread with $BTC, but the whole alt crowd is outpacing Bitcoin's gain. Nothing wild, just a modest shuffle across the board.
